process_area.title: Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response

value_stream.name: Consumer Data Privacy & Data Protection Program

fields.Participants: IT Security, DPO, SOC, Customer Service, LP
fields.Trigger: Suspected breach signal (SIEM alert, report, anomaly)

workflows.name: Personal Data Breach Detection, Triage & Incident Activation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "IT Security/SOC detect potential breach via monitoring" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reportable personal-data breach" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Detection-delay risk**: Breach undetected, eroding notification window; mitigated by monitoring and triage SLA
System Touchpoints: - SIEM/SOC (links to VS-27); incident response case; breach response playbook

steps.activity: IT Security/SOC detect potential breach via monitoring (links to VS-27); log incident; perform initial triage and severity scoring
IT Security/DPO assess whether incident constitutes a reportable personal-data breach (confidentiality/integrity/availability of personal data); activate incident response if yes
DPO activates breach response team (IT Security, Legal, Comms, HR, Customer Service, executive); appoint incident commander; start 72-hour clock for NPC notification (W3059)

fields.Participants: IT Security, DPO, Legal, Forensics, affected Business Process Owners

workflows.name: Breach Containment, Forensic Investigation & Scope Assessment

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "IT Security contains breach" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag for investigation of "investigate root cause, entry vector, and timeline" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope-uncertainty risk**: Under/over-stating affected subjects; mitigated by ROPA-driven scoping and forensics
System Touchpoints: - Forensic tooling/evidence preservation; ROPA (W3042); incident case

steps.activity: IT Security contains breach (isolate systems, revoke access, reset credentials, patch); preserves forensic evidence and logs
Forensics/IT Security investigate root cause, entry vector, and timeline; determine data categories, volume, and subjects affected
DPO/Business Process Owners assess scope using ROPA (W3042): which data, how many subjects, sensitivity, and likely harm; feeds notification decisions

fields.Participants: DPO, Legal, IT Security, Compliance, Records

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepare NPC breach notification" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-submit of "submits notification to NPC per prescribed format/channel" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Records/Legal retain breach documentation per VS-88" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Late-notification risk**: Missing 72-hour window triggers penalties; mitigated by activation-to-notification playbook and templates
System Touchpoints: - NPC notification template/channel; records retention (links to VS-88); incident case

steps.activity: DPO/Legal prepare NPC breach notification (nature, data categories, approximate subjects, likely harm, measures taken) within 72 hours of knowledge where required
DPO submits notification to NPC per prescribed format/channel; coordinates any law-enforcement notification (cybercrime, PNP-ACG) where applicable
Records/Legal retain breach documentation per VS-88; support NPC follow-up inquiries and supplementary reports as scope refines

fields.Participants: DPO, Comms, Customer Service, Legal, IT
fields.Trigger: Breach likely to cause harm to subjects
fields.Volume: Up to affected subjects (could be large for loyalty/ecommerce breach)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "DPO/Comms draft subject notification" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "Comms/Customer Service deliver notification to affected subjects via appropriate" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track remediation uptake" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reputational risk**: Poor notification damages trust; mitigated by timely, transparent, supportive communication
System Touchpoints: - Customer communication (links to VS-13/VS-14); incident case; remediation tracking

steps.activity: DPO/Comms draft subject notification (what happened, data involved, harm, remediation, contact); Legal reviews; calibrate to NPC guidance
Comms/Customer Service deliver notification to affected subjects via appropriate channel; staff dedicated support hotline/chat; log inquiries
IT/DPO provide remediation (credit-monitoring equivalent, password reset, fraud-alert guidance, free identity-protection where offered); track remediation uptake

workflows.name: Cyber Insurance Coordination & Breach Cost Recovery

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "review cyber-liability / breach-response policy for coverage, deductibles,…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-compile of "compile breach cost ledger" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile to incident case" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
- operational: panel-vendor pre-engagement and notice-condition checklist
Pain Points / Risks: - **Coverage-gap risk**: Costs exceed coverage or notice missed; mitigated by panel-vendor pre-engagement and notice-condition checklist
System Touchpoints: - Insurance claim registry (links to W59/VS-26); breach cost ledger; cyber policy record

steps.activity: Risk/Insurance review cyber-liability / breach-response policy for coverage, deductibles, panel-vendor requirements; notify insurer/broker within policy window
Finance/Risk compile breach cost ledger (forensics, legal, notification, remediation, regulatory penalty, business loss); engage panel vendors per policy where required
Risk/Finance negotiate settlement; post recovery; reconcile to incident case; capture lessons for coverage adequacy

fields.Participants: DPO, IT Security, Legal, Internal Audit, affected Process Owners

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-review of "DPO facilitates post-incident review" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-assign of "assign owners and deadlines" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "Internal Audit/DPO verify effectiveness" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
- operational: tracked actions and playbook updates
Pain Points / Risks: - **Repeat-incident risk**: Lessons not embedded; mitigated by tracked actions and playbook updates
System Touchpoints: - Post-incident review record; action tracker; risk register (links to VS-21); playbook CMS

steps.activity: DPO facilitates post-incident review: timeline, root cause, detection/containment/notification effectiveness, gaps
IT Security/Process Owners define corrective actions (controls, monitoring, training, architecture); assign owners and deadlines; track to closure
Internal Audit/DPO verify effectiveness; update breach response playbook and risk register (links to VS-21); report to Steering Committee and board

fields.Participants: DPO, Data Analytics, Compliance, Steering Committee

workflows.name: Privacy Metrics, Compliance Reporting & DPO Board Reporting

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-post of "posture, breach incidents, remediation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "reports compliance status to Steering Committee and board" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "DPO publishes annual privacy report" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Visibility risk**: Privacy risk invisible to leadership; mitigated by board-level reporting
System Touchpoints: - Privacy metrics dashboard (links to VS-28); board reporting (links to VS-36); compliance calendar

steps.activity: DPO/Data Analytics maintain privacy metrics: DSAR volume/SLA, consent coverage, training completion, processor posture, breach incidents, remediation status
DPO reports compliance status to Steering Committee and board (links to VS-36); highlights risks, regulatory changes, and resourcing needs
DPO publishes annual privacy report (program maturity, incidents, improvements); supports external/audit assurance (links to VS-21/VS-22)

fields.Participants: DPO, Legal, Internal Audit, Compliance, Records, IT Security
fields.Trigger: NPC investigation, complaint, or scheduled audit

workflows.name: Data Privacy Audit, NPC Investigation Response & Remediation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "records, DPIAs, incident files" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System continuous audit of "Audit/Compliance support with control evidence, interviews, and walkthroughs" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "updates risk register and controls" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-504 (ensure controlled execution — Breach Detection, Notification & NPC Regulatory Response (PA-91.3).)
- operational: complete ROPA/DPIA/consent records and audit readiness
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adverse-finding risk**: Inadequate records lead to penalties; mitigated by complete ROPA/DPIA/consent records and audit readiness
System Touchpoints: - Audit evidence repository (links to VS-88); NPC correspondence; controls register (links to VS-22)

steps.activity: DPO/Legal coordinate NPC investigation or complaint response; assemble evidence (ROPA, consent records, DPIAs, incident files) per VS-88
Internal Audit/Compliance support with control evidence, interviews, and walkthroughs; Legal manages privileged content and regulator communication
DPO executes remediation per NPC directive or finding; reports closure; updates risk register and controls (links to VS-21/VS-22)
